name: Sumomomo Fukufuku Hot Station
original_name: すももも ぷくぷくホットステーション
source:
Main character finds a strange envelope on his way to employment center after graduation. He is suddenly invited to live in the place he was born together with many girls. This is like an entertainment district, but not money is needed!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角毕业后前往就业中心，在路上发现一个奇怪的信封。他突然被邀请和许多女孩一起住在自己的出生地。这里像娱乐街，却不需要钱！

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
